name: nhcx
description: Agent skills for building on the National Health Claims Exchange (NHCX), one per use case in episode order: nhcx-coverage, nhcx-insurance, nhcx-preauth, nhcx-claim, nhcx-payment, nhcx-communication and nhcx-reprocess. Each builds its use case into a hospital information system or a claims desk, held to the NHCX package's pinned FHIR bundles, and installs and runs alone. Also carries /nhcx-decode-error, /nhcx-preflight and /nhcx-prove-seal, and the nhcx-call-debugger agent.

interface.shortDescription: Build an NHCX claims integration, one use case at a time.
interface.longDescription: India's health claims exchange, written as skills an agent reads before it writes code. One skill per use case, from coverage to reprocess. Each checks what the system already has, builds only what is missing, and holds every bundle to the NHCX package's pinned samples.
defaultPrompt: Add NHCX policy search and coverage eligibility to this hospital system.
File the NHCX claim at discharge from this system.
